text.hero.title:
From Barrel
to Botanical
text.hero.tagline: Slow-poured whiskey, hand-ground juniper, field-picked chamomile. Spirits made the patient way.
text.craft.heading: Nothing rushed. Nothing hidden.
text.craft.body: Every bottle starts the same way it has for generations — with hands, time, and raw ingredients you can name. We pour from the barrel by hand, grind our juniper one crank at a time, and pick our botanicals at first light. Replace this copy with your own brand story.
text.process.heading: Three steps, all by hand
text.process.card1.title: Slow-Poured Whiskey
text.process.card1.body: Drawn straight from the bunghole of a charred oak barrel and decanted by hand — never hurried.
text.process.card2.title: Hand-Ground Juniper
text.process.card2.body: Wild juniper berries crushed one crank at a time, releasing oils a machine would burn off.
text.process.card3.title: Field-Picked Botanicals
text.process.card3.body: Chamomile and wild blooms gathered by hand at golden hour, basket by basket.
text.story.heading: Rugged hands, honest spirits
text.story.body: Waxed canvas, weathered wood, and a refusal to cut corners. This is where you tell people who you are and why it matters. Keep it short, keep it true.
text.closing.heading: Taste what patience makes.
text.closing.body: Find Wildhand at your local bottle shop, or order direct.
